missedEssential.fact: RC1: session_test.go:171-173 waits for syscall.Kill(pid, 0) != nil on both the shell and `sleep 300`, but kill(pid, 0) succeeds on a zombie.
RC1 is reproduced deterministically with a slow subreaper wrapper: REAP_EVERY=100ms passes and REAP_EVERY=6s fails.
RC2: the comment at session.go:232-238 that closing ptmx reliably unblocks a pending Read on Linux is false.
With SHELL=/bin/sh and an escaped child, Close took 6.004s, logged 'session did not exit after SIGKILL and ptmx close', and done stayed false.
After the fix, with SHELL=/bin/sh the test still fails because the child is alive (the deferred design gap), but there is no WARN, Close takes ~4s, and done closes, on Linux only.
